Title: n8n: Prototype Pollution via VM Expression Engine Sandbox Escape Leads to Denial of Service
Description:
An authenticated user able to create or edit a workflow expression could abuse the expression engine's array-element access to obtain a reference to a host built-in and pollute its prototype in the main n8n process, leading to a denial of service.

Both self-hosted and cloud instances running the VM expression engine are affected.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 1.123.67, all versions starting from 2.0.0-rc.0 before 2.31.5, all versions starting from 2.32.0 before 2.32.1
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 1.123.67 before 2.0.0-rc.0, all versions starting from 2.31.5 before 2.32.0, all versions starting from 2.32.1
